claims.text: The account describes a sturdy shrub to 1.4 m with relatively large leaves; its large axillary flowers are white with pink dots, and it has five carpels.
claims.locator: Printed p. 709, individual Agathosma insignis account; SANBI e-Flora v1.36 Morphology row 7044 (source identifier 14398.0)
claims.placeTimeScope: Morphology as summarized in the 2012 regional flora account; no sex-specific or population sample is given.
claims.lifeStatus: Extant regional flora account; cultivation status not specified.

gaps: Developmental stages, sex-specific traits, variation, measured samples and diagnostic limits have not been reviewed.

claims.text: The account gives September to November as the flowering period.
claims.locator: Printed p. 709, flowering period in the individual Agathosma insignis account
claims.placeTimeScope: Phenology stated in the 2012 South African regional account; observation locations and annual sampling are not specified.
